stance: Growth: Q3 advance GDP printed 3.4% SAAR, up from 2.2% in Q2. Spending is strong (September retail sales +0.77% m/m). October core capex orders +1.18% after +0.83% points to firm business investment, while headline durables slowed to +0.22% after +1.99%. October IP fell 0.43% m/m after +0.73%, capacity utilization 76.36%: output softer, one month only. CARTS October ex-auto +1.0% m/m is unconfirmed (one source). ISM services 54.5 verified; ISM manufacturing 55.5 unconfirmed. Watch IP revisions, CARTS, retail control group, core capex.
